decision.reference: Authorization bead bu-0gy2i8 for implementation bead bu-jkhucb (PR #4743, OpenCode Go Qwen3.7 Plus upper pricing tier starts strictly above 256K, so exactly 256000 context tokens bill the lower tier). Reviewed before: main 7cbcbfa13faa1fbe593d6a0fbb57555adeeed888 as recorded in bu-izzsar; approved subject: PR #4743 head fd03ef56adf8a367083177bd52b8fac65cbc39cd plus the reviewer-computed clause (spec-clause.patch) and request. Governing requirement REQ-dashboard-api-072 (Pricing and Cost Estimation) in openspec/specs/dashboard-api/spec.md, whose ID-only header lands in this same change; the change adds one scenario inside the block. The provider card does not define K; the clause records the coordinator decision to count K as 1,000 tokens (repo convention, as for the 100001 threshold), which bills 256001-262144 tokens at the upper tier if 1,024 were meant. This exact manifest requires its own independent review and protected-main publication before consumption; provenance text grants no runtime admission.

owners.reason: The Qwen3.7 Plus upper tier now starts at context_threshold 256001 because the OpenCode Go card bands it as '> 256K tokens' and tier selection is inclusive, so exactly 256000 context tokens bill at the lower tier. The retained upper-tier probe moves from context_tokens=256_000 to 256_001 and keeps the same 6.0 USD expectation; the lower-tier probe and the flat minimax assertions are unchanged.
